title: Fantastic Hip Apartment In Great Neighborhood!
description:
Located in one of Nashville's hottest neighborhoods this funky and charming apartment is the main floor of the house. Short walk to fabulous Five Points East Nashville where you'll find some of the best restaurants, bars, shops, galleries and happenings Nashville has to offer. Around the corner from groceries, coffee shops and more stores and restaurants. 10 min from airport and 5 min from downtown. Great spot for couples, families, solo adventurers and business travelers.

The space
This spacious apartment has a big kitchen with everything you need to cook.   The futon couch open up to a comfortable queen sized bed so there's plenty of room for two couples or a family.  For entertainment the TV is loaded with a house Netflix account for all your viewing desires or grab one of the board games for more fun.

Guest access
There is a fully stocked laundry room you are welcome to use.  It located at the end of the driveway, the door to the left.  You can also use this space to leave luggage before your check in time or after you check out.
